concerns.text: The fallback trigger in T012 adds an extra condition on the paired‑t‑test p‑value (p ≤ 0.05) before augmentation is performed. The specification (FR‑012) requires fallback only when **RMSE > 0.5 eV OR R² < 0.70**. Adding the p‑value clause weakens the requirement and may prevent the mandated augmentation, violating FR‑012.

T004’s verification only logs a warning when the feature matrix contains fewer than 500 rows, but the success criterion SC‑005 explicitly requires **at least 500 valid samples**. Allowing the pipeline to continue without aborting weakens the acceptance criterion, violating SC‑005.

T001 claims to satisfy SC‑004 (runtime ≤ 30 min) by checking for the phrase “Pipeline completed successfully”. This does not verify the runtime constraint; SC‑004 is instead enforced later by T014/T017. Claiming compliance here weakens the requirement and misrepresents the verification scope.
